_comment: All player-facing PokeRogue-bridge flavor text. Resolved SERVER-side with String.format: %s = text, %d = number, in the order documented per key. Rewrite freely; keep the placeholders.
pokerogue.presentation.run.ended: %s woke up — the dream ended at wave %d.
_run.victory: chat: %s = player, %d = final wave; title has no placeholders; subtitle: %s = player, %d = final wave
pokerogue.presentation.run.victory.chat: %s's dream came true — the run was won at wave %d!
pokerogue.presentation.run.victory.title: A dream came true
_milestone: chat: %s = player, %s = milestone name; title: %s = milestone name; subtitle: %s = player
pokerogue.presentation.milestone.title: %s
_wake: shown privately to the runner when their run ends; %d = final wave
pokerogue.presentation.wake.title: You wake up…
pokerogue.presentation.wake.subtitle: You remember reaching wave %d
pokerogue.presentation.wake.subtitle.vic: You remember winning it all at wave %d
pokerogue.presentation.wake.chat: The dream fades. You made it to wave %d.
pokerogue.presentation.wake.chat.victory: The dream fades — but you won it, at wave %d. It felt real.
_tab.suffix: appended to the tab-list name while dreaming; %d = current wave (rendered gray by DreamingPresence)
_enter: the /pokerogue enter (pay-to-dream) flow; insufficient: %d = fee, %d = balance; no_account: %s = pokerogue username; success: %d = fee
pokerogue.enter.not_linked: You are not linked to a PokeRogue account — /pokerogue link <username> first.
pokerogue.enter.no_economy: The server economy is unavailable — entry cannot be paid right now. Tell staff.
pokerogue.enter.db_down: The dream is out of reach (PokeRogue database unreachable). Nothing was charged — try again later.
pokerogue.enter.no_account: Your linked PokeRogue account '%s' no longer exists. Nothing was charged — re-link with /pokerogue link.
pokerogue.enter.insufficient: Entering the dream costs %d, but you only have %d. Nothing was charged.
pokerogue.enter.not_enabled: The dream gate is not active yet on the PokeRogue side. Your fee was refunded — tell staff.
pokerogue.enter.db_failed_refund: Something went wrong arming your run; your fee was refunded. Try again later.
pokerogue.enter.success: Paid %d — your next NEW classic run is armed. Sweet dreams.
_payout: repeatable classic payout; display: %d = wave band, %d = key count; earned: %d = key count, %d = wave band
pokerogue.payout.earned: Your dream left something behind: %d pokemon-crate key(s) for reaching wave %d. Claim them with /pokerogue claim.
